## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?  
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive. SPY in CORRECTION (1W: -0.86% | 1M: +0.93%) and QQQ in CORRECTION (1W: -2.31% | 1M: +0.55%) show short-term pullbacks while sector breadth keeps the market balanced — confirmation: broad sector participation and mixed major-index momentum.

2. Primary Risk Drivers?  
Fear showing mild pickup with VXX ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.22% | 1M: +4.48%) ↑ rising, while credit is neutral with HYG CORRECTION (1W: -0.06% | 1M: +0.56%) → flat and LQD CORRECTION (1W: -0.26% | 1M: +0.32%) → flat; commodity strength in energy/copper (XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.03% | 1M: +13.19%) ↑ rising; CPER ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.46% | 1M: +7.15%) ↑ rising) is a second driver.

3. Financial Conditions Signal?  
Neutral overall: TLT in CORRECTION (1W: -0.81% | 1M: +0.07%) → flat and SPY/TLT showing no clear bias, leaving financial conditions balanced between risk tightening and cyclical support.

📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?  
Energy leading: XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.03% | 1M: +13.19%) ↑ rising and BNO ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.23% | 1M: +13.70%) ↑ rising; Tech lagging: XLK BELOW TREND (1W: -4.03% | 1M: -1.54%) ↓ falling and ARKK BELOW TREND (1W: -7.94% | 1M: -6.22%) ↓ falling — style: cyclicals/value showing relative strength versus growth.

5. US vs Global?  
US equities mixed with SPY CORRECTION (1W: -0.86% | 1M: +0.93%), EM shows recovery in breadth but regional stress: EEM CORRECTION (1W: -1.23% | 1M: +5.97%) and China FXI BELOW TREND (1W: -3.05% | 1M: -2.76%) ↓ falling.

6. Speculative Appetite?  
Speculation cooling: IBIT BELOW TREND (1W: -14.48% | 1M: -15.00%) ↓ falling and ARKK BELOW TREND (1W: -7.94% | 1M: -6.22%) ↓ falling, while small caps IWM CORRECTION (1W: -0.74% | 1M: +5.63%) show selective risk-taking.

🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?  
Base/industrial metals and oil strong: CPER ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.46% | 1M: +7.15%) ↑ rising and USO ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.39% | 1M: +12.34%) ↑ rising, while precious metals show short-term profit taking with GLD CORRECTION (1W: -4.58% | 1M: +14.06%) ↓ falling.

8. Energy Trend?  
Energy clear leader: XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.03% | 1M: +13.19%) ↑ rising, BNO ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.23% | 1M: +13.70%) ↑ rising; natural gas weak with UNG CORRECTION (1W: -11.70% | 1M: +7.63%) ↓ falling.

🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?  
CONFIRMED strength in energy/materials (XLE and CPER both 1W/1M positive = ABOVE TREND). MAJOR divergence across core ETFs — SPY CORRECTION, XLF RECOVERY (1W: +1.00% | 1M: -2.55%) and TLT CORRECTION — indicates mixed momentum and suppresses a one-sided regime call.

10. Portfolio Direction?  
Favor cyclicals/energy exposure given XLE ABOVE TREND and commodity strength; reduce exposure to large-cap tech and thematic ETFs (XLK BELOW TREND, ARKK BELOW TREND) and monitor volatility/VXX and credit spreads for regime drift.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?  
BULLISH: XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.03% | 1M: +13.19%) — watch continuation on oil strength; Materials/Industrials (XME CORRECTION (1W: -2.93% | 1M: +15.86%)) for cyclical expansion.  
BEARISH: XLK BELOW TREND (1W: -4.03% | 1M: -1.54%) — watch for further tech weakness; Thematics (ARKK BELOW TREND (1W: -7.94% | 1M: -6.22%)) remain under pressure.

12. Commodities to Watch?  
BULLISH: BNO ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.23% | 1M: +13.70%) and CPER ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.46% | 1M: +7.15%) — watch oil/copper consolidation.  
BEARISH: GLD CORRECTION (1W: -4.58% | 1M: +14.06%) — monitor for renewed safe-haven flows; UNG CORRECTION (1W: -11.70% | 1M: +7.63%) if gas weakness continues.

13. Key Levels?  
VXX 20 (volatility complacency), HYG/LQD ~0.80 (credit health inflection), XLK/XLF 2.0 (growth vs value pivot), SPY 1W downside confirmation around recent pullback lows.

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive, offset by corrections in major indices (SPY and QQQ) that leave the market balanced. Energy and materials showing strength while tech and thematic ETFs show notable weakness — monitor VXX and credit spreads for any regime shift.
